details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc carrying only host metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory, the working directory, and the npm/node user agent. The same beacon is also fired when index.js is imported, and index.js exports a no-op Proxy so that importing applications do not crash. No credentials, tokens, environment values, wallet data or file contents are collected or transmitted, and no further payload is downloaded or executed. The package describes itself as an authorized dependency-confusion test.
